name: Arlysia, Outer Wall
desc1: A high stone wall surrounds the city of Arlysia. Guards placed along
desc2: the wall in strategic locations help keep the area near the city walls
desc3: safe from harm. Even from this distance, the guards manage to look
desc4: tense and alert, as if they were expecting an attack at any time.
desc5: There are gated entrances into the city at the north and south ends.
